# Project Instructions

This is a Python project managed with `uv`.

## Conventions

- Format with `ruff format` and lint with `ruff check` before committing.
- Tests live in `tests/` and run with `pytest`.
- Keep functions small and prefer pure helpers for anything testable.

## Layout

- `src/` — application code
- `tests/` — unit and integration tests
- `docs/` — user-facing documentation

Ask before adding a new third-party dependency.
